description.narrative: All people affected by conflict, particularly vulnerable, marginalized, and discriminated individuals, are able to safely and effectively meet their immediate needs, including access to critical protection services. Support the local humanitarian system and local partners to facilitate access to critical basic needs. Provide immediate and direct support when and where assessed necessary. Provision of water Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) services, cash transfers. Hygiene promotion and protection activities. Most likely to be a partner led response but may be operational where necessary.
